svg.title: What sits between a shelf button and object storage
svg.desc: Five layers: the DCC integration, the pure guess_pipeline_path function, publish_file, ReviewClient, and the two HTTPS destinations — the v1 API with a bearer token, and object storage with a presigned PUT that carries no Authorization header.
svg.text: WHAT SITS BETWEEN A SHELF BUTTON AND OBJECT STORAGE
DCC integration
Blender add-on in Properties, Output, ReView · Nuke menu Ctrl+Alt+P and addAfterRender
Maya shelf button · Houdini ROP post-render script · Prism publish hook
review.dcc.guess_pipeline_path
A pure function: filename to PROJ/SQ010/SH0100/anim.
Replace THIS ONE function if your studio names files differently — do not fork the add-ons.
review.publish.publish_file
sha256 read in 1 MB chunks · one uuid reused across both API calls
returns PublishResult(media_id, version_path, published, created)
review.client.ReviewClient
urllib only · 60 s default timeout, 3600 s for transfers
retries 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 — 4 attempts, 0.5 s base, 30 s ceiling, 25 % jitter, Retry-After honoured
writes replayed only when they carry an Idempotency-Key
HTTPS to /api/v1
Authorization: Bearer rvk_...
HTTPS to object storage
presigned PUT · no Authorization header
Zero third-party dependency
The interpreter inside Maya, Nuke, Houdini or Blender cannot be asked to pip install anything.
Errors: ReviewApiError (.status, .code) · ReviewTransportError · ReviewConfigError — branch on .code.
